Progress

Progress bars display the current completion status of a task or process as a percentage.

Basic Progress Bar

A default determinate progress bar.

HTML
<div class="zak-progress">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:40%;"></div>
</div>

Progress with Label

Pair the bar with an accessible label above it.

Uploading assets
HTML
<div>
    <span style="font-weight:500;">Uploading assets</span>
</div>
<div class="zak-progress">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:62%;"></div>
</div>

Progress with Value

Show the numeric percentage inside or beside the bar.

75%
Installing dependencies24 of 32
HTML
<div class="zak-progress">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:75%;">75%</div>
</div>
<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;">
    <span>Installing dependencies</span><span>24 of 32</span>
</div>

Progress Color Variants

Use semantic modifiers to reflect success, danger, warning, or info.

HTML
<div class="zak-progress"><div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:30%;"></div></div>
<div class="zak-progress zak-progress-success"><div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:45%;"></div></div>
<div class="zak-progress zak-progress-danger"><div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:60%;"></div></div>
<div class="zak-progress zak-progress-warning"><div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:70%;"></div></div>
<div class="zak-progress zak-progress-info"><div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:85%;"></div></div>

Striped Progress

Add diagonal stripes with .zak-progress-bar-striped or the container-level .striped modifier.

HTML
<div class="zak-progress striped"><div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:40%;"></div></div>
<div class="zak-progress"><div class="zak-progress-bar zak-progress-bar-striped" style="width:70%;"></div></div>

Animated Stripes

Combine stripes with .animated (or .zak-progress-bar-animated) to animate them.

HTML
<div class="zak-progress animated"><div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:50%;"></div></div>
<div class="zak-progress"><div class="zak-progress-bar zak-progress-bar-striped zak-progress-bar-animated" style="width:80%;"></div></div>

Multiple Progress Bars

Stack several bars vertically for multi-step tasks.

Design
Development
Testing
HTML
<div>
    <div>Design</div>
    <div class="zak-progress"><div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:100%;"></div></div>
</div>
<div>
    <div>Development</div>
    <div class="zak-progress zak-progress-info"><div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:65%;"></div></div>
</div>

Progress with Icons

Add an icon next to the label or inside the bar area.

Downloading 84%
HTML
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;">
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;">
        <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">...</svg>
        <span>Downloading</span>
    </div>
    <span>84%</span>
</div>
<div class="zak-progress"><div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:84%;"></div></div>

Progress Sizes

Use .zak-progress-thin or .zak-progress-2px for slimmer bars.

HTML
<div class="zak-progress"><div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:50%;"></div></div>  <!-- default -->
<div class="zak-progress zak-progress-thin">...</div>                <!-- 0.375rem -->
<div class="zak-progress zak-progress-2px">...</div>                <!-- 2px -->

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
.zak-progress            /* Track */
.zak-progress-bar         /* Filled bar */
.zak-progress-bar-striped /* Striped pattern */
.zak-progress-bar-animated/* Animated stripes */
.zak-progress-success     /* Success color */
.zak-progress-danger      /* Danger color */
.zak-progress-warning     /* Warning color */
.zak-progress-info        /* Info color */
.zak-progress-thin        /* 0.375rem height */
.zak-progress-2px         /* 2px height */
.striped                  /* Container shorthand for stripes */
.animated                 /* Container shorthand for animation */

Accessibility

  • Add role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, and aria-valuemax for screen readers.
  • If no label is visible, provide an aria-label or use aria-labelledby.
  • For indeterminate progress, omit aria-valuenow and set aria-busy="true" on the container.
HTML
<div class="zak-progress" role="progressbar"
     aria-label="Upload progress"
     aria-valuenow="62" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100">
    <div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:62%;"></div>
</div>
